Core internal transfer handling bot checks, cooldown, max tx limit, fee swap and ETH distribution before updating balances.
Public ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that delegates to _transfer and decrements allowance via _approve.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the Uniswap V2 router and sends ETH to the router path.
Splits contract ETH balance in two and transfers it to the fee wallets.
Owner-only function that sets the router, creates the pair, adds liquidity and enables trading and swap.
Owner-only function that flags an array of addresses as bots.

Owner-only function clearing the bot flag of an address.
Manually swaps the contract token balance; restricted to _feeAddrWallet1.
Manually distributes contract ETH; restricted to _feeAddrWallet1.
Internal wrapper that routes a transfer to _transferStandard.
Internal reflection transfer that updates _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects fee.
Internal team fee accumulator adding reflected team amount to the contract balance.
Internal reflection accounting that reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldown feature.
Owner-only toggle for the tradingOpen flag.
Internal helper computing r/t transfer, fee and team values for a transfer.
Internal helper computing the reflection rate from current supply.
Internal helper returning the reflection and token supply values.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve.
Returns the token balance derived from the stored reflection balance.
Owner-only renounce of ownership setting _owner to the zero address.
Owner-only reset of _maxTxAmount to the full token supply.
Mapping of reflection balances per address; the primary accounting store.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner to spender.
Mapping of addresses blocked from transferring.
Mapping of addresses to timestamp of next allowed buy.
Total reflection supply reduced by reflection fees.
Accumulated token fee total.
First fee percentage used in _getTValues.
Second/team fee percentage used in _getTValues.
Payable fee wallet receiving half of the ETH and privileged manual functions.
Payable fee wallet receiving half of the ETH.
Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity.

Flag gating whether trading is enabled.

Flag enabling automatic swap and ETH distribution in transfers.
Flag enabling the anti-bot cooldown check.
Maximum amount per transaction enforced on buys.
Contract owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, owner, spender and privileged claim checks.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address when transfer delegates to _transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when deducting the allowance inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument when approve delegates to _approve.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1, an owner-controlled privileged check.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1, an owner-controlled privileged check.
Constructor reads msg.sender through _msgSender to mint the supply and set ownership.
block.timestamp drives the cooldown check and cooldown[to] update, introducing timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controlled time.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer at the end of execution.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute r/t amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current reflection rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain rSupply and tSupply.
_getRate derives the rate from _rTotal via _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_transferStandard writes the sender and recipient reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard reads _rOwned to subtract and add reflection amounts.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team amount.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection and token fee.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team token amount to reflections.
_takeTeam reads the contract reflection balance before accumulating the team fee.
_takeTeam writes the accumulated team fee into _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee reads _rTotal before subtracting the reflection fee.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee reads _tFeeTotal before adding the token fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_getValues reads _feeAddr1 as the tax fee passed to _getTValues.
_getValues reads _feeAddr2 as the team fee passed to _getTValues.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and the sender is not the pair.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap router swap while inSwap is set but state is not settled.
_transfer reaches the external router swap through swapTokensForEth before finishing the recipient balance update path.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap call.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router to query WETH and to swap.
swapTokensForEth writes the router allowance through _approve.
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to external fee wallets.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance is greater than zero.
sendETHToFee computes amount.div(2) with SafeMath division for each wallet.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet1 as the first transfer target.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet2 as the second transfer target.
_transfer reads the bots mapping to block flagged addresses.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair for the buy-side branch and trading exemptions.
_transfer reads cooldown[to] for the anti-bot timestamp comparison.
_transfer writes the new cooldown timestamp for the recipient.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the per-transaction limit.
_transfer branches on cooldownEnabled.
_transfer branches on swapEnabled to trigger auto swap.
_transfer reads inSwap as the swap reentrancy guard.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to determine the contract token balance.
Local contractTokenBalance in _transfer holds the balance used for the swap.
Local contractETHBalance in _transfer gates the fee distribution call.
openTrading calls createPair on the factory.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading reads uniswapV2Router for factory, WETH and liquidity calls.
openTrading writes the new uniswapV2Router address.
openTrading reads uniswapV2Pair for the approval of the pair contract.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to true.
openTrading sets _maxTxAmount to the full token supply.
openTrading reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner with msg.sender.
Constructor writes the full reflection supply into _rOwned of the deployer.
Constructor sets the payable _feeAddrWallet1 address.
Constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet1.
Constructor sets the payable _feeAddrWallet2 address.
Constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet2.
Constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address.
setBots reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots is guarded by onlyOwner.
delBot writes false into the bots mapping for the given address.
delBot reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with SafeMath mul and div on _tTotal.
setMaxTxPercent reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxPercent is guarded by onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
setCooldownEnabled reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner.
setTradingOpen writes the tradingOpen flag.
setTradingOpen reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
setTradingOpen is guarded by onlyOwner.
removeStrictTxLimit resets _maxTxAmount to the full token supply.
removeStrictTxLimit reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
removeStrictTxLimit is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership reads _owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to the zero address.
balanceOf converts the stored _rOwned reflection balance to a token amount.
transferFrom reads the caller allowance from _allowances before deducting it.
approve reads _allowances to build the new allowance value.
approve writes the new allowance into _allowances through _approve.
_transfer reads _owner for trading exemptions and bot-check bypass, granting owner privileges.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualswap compares msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualsend compares msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1 before sending ETH.
